project.description: CRM deploy from git source (local bare repo) via docker compose

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: DRY_RUN
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: true = build images only, skip up -d

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: set -e echo "=== CRM deploy ENV=$ENV DRY_RUN=$DRY_RUN TARGET=$TARGET ===" git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/e/code/crm.git git -C /mnt/e/code/crm push /mnt/e/code/crm.git master 2>/dev/null || echo "push skipped (no new commits)" rm -rf /tmp/crm-build git clone /mnt/e/code/crm.git /tmp/crm-build cd /tmp/crm-build test -f docker-compose.yml || { echo "ERROR: docker-compose.yml missing"; exit 1; } cp /mnt/e/code/crm/.env .env || { echo "ERROR: .env missing"; exit 1; } docker version docker compose build if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then echo "DRY_RUN=true skip up -d and health check" else docker rm -f crm-redis crm-mysql crm-backend crm-frontend 2>/dev/null || echo "no old containers" docker compose up -d --remove-orphans docker compose ps curl -fsS http://localhost:8082/health || echo "WARN: frontend /health failed" curl -fsS http://localhost:8081/actuator/health || echo "WARN: backend health failed" fi echo "=== deploy done ==="
